1. Don't add code comments.
2. Copy Netflix UI style across the application.
3. This is a Netflix clone project named BeatWig.
4. Make sure the UI is beautiful and responsive.
5. Use the types in the types dir.
6. Make sure to follow the current project structure and conventions.
7. We'll be using the TMDB API for movie data so make sure the UI accommodates that.
8. We'll be using firebase service account and google auth for authentication so make sure the UI accommodates that.
9. Make sure to use shadcn components and shadcn colors.
10. Make sure to break down the components into smaller reusable components wherever possible.
